tasks.EquilateralTriangleProperties: Utilize properties of an equilateral triangle to set up equations for side length and coordinates.
tasks.ParabolaIntersection: Find intersection points on the parabola that form the other two vertices of the triangle.
tasks.SideLengthCalculation: Calculate the distance between these points to find the side length of the equilateral triangle.
tasks.VertexPositioning: Determine the position of one vertex at the origin (0,0) since it coincides with the parabola's vertex.
